decisions.reason: Although management has some incentive to justify its earlier launch, by 2022 an audio and web conferencing offer looks less central to the firm's infrastructure-led strategy and weak later visibility makes poor performance harder to explain away as temporary.

This service is tightly tied to the firm's owned metro and data-centre assets, already had visible adoption, and fits the publicly stated move toward high-bandwidth integrated infrastructure, so escalation of commitment strongly favors retention.
A voice number ordering portal supports software-defined real-time provisioning, so prior investment and strategic fit make management likely to keep backing it even if traction has been modest.

Direct voice network connection remains close to the firm's established enterprise communications business, and sunk network and customer-support commitments would typically keep management from withdrawing it quickly despite slower growth in voice.
